sangre: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished ORIGINAL Spanish medical study MIND MAP poster, landscape 3:2, very high resolution, white background, navy typography, teal, burgundy and gold accents. Supporting reference image: the provided Preparatoria Ben Carson logo; include this exact institutional logo clearly at upper left, preserve its wording and appearance, do not invent a different logo. Title exactly 'DIFERENCIAL LEUCOCITARIO'. Subtitle 'Sangre · Morfofunción'. A true connected mind map: central blood drop and five anatomically recognizable white cells with subtle curved branches reaching FIVE spacious cards. Each card has a realistic medical illustration of that particular cell and these EXACT concise texts: 'NEUTRÓFILOS', '60–70 %', 'Núcleo de 3–5 lóbulos', 'Fagocitan bacterias'; 'LINFOCITOS', '25–33 %', 'Núcleo redondo prominente', 'B, T y NK: funciones diferentes'; 'MONOCITOS', '3–8 %', 'Núcleo arriñonado', 'Fagocitosis y presentación de antígenos'; 'EOSINÓFILOS', '2–4 %', 'Núcleo bilobulado', 'Parásitos y respuestas alérgicas'; 'BASÓFILOS', '<0,5 %', 'Gránulos violeta oscuros', 'Liberan histamina y heparina'. Cell illustrations must accurately show neutrophil segmented nucleus, small lymphocyte large nucleus, monocyte kidney-shaped nucleus, eosinophil red-orange granules and bilobed nucleus, basophil dark purple granules. Bottom integrated callout 'NO CONFUNDAS PORCENTAJE CON RECUENTO ABSOLUTO' followed by 'Recuento absoluto = leucocitos totales × fracción del tipo celular' and example '8.000/µL × 0,65 = 5.200 neutrófilos/µL'. Footer exactly 'Valores del cuadro 18.6 de Saladin · Orientan el estudio; no establecen un diagnóstico'. Legible editorial design, real illustrated content and connections, no generic icons, no microscopic unreadable text, no invented percentages, do not imply that all range endpoints must sum to 100. Keep ample margins and balanced whitespace. This is a learning map rather than a clinical diagnostic tool.
sentidos: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished ORIGINAL Spanish medical learning MIND MAP poster, landscape 3:2, very high resolution, white paper, navy text, teal and gold accents. Supporting reference is original Preparatoria Ben Carson logo: include it clearly top left preserving the same letters, wording and shape. Title 'RETINA Y FOTOTRANSDUCCIÓN', subtitle 'Sentidos · Morfofunción'. Central realistic rod photoreceptor next to cone, drawn anatomically credible, with branches to FOUR spacious illustrated teaching cards. Card1 'EN OSCURIDAD' with three connected steps 'GMPc disponible' → 'Canales catiónicos abiertos' → 'Liberación de glutamato'. Card2 'CUANDO LLEGA LA LUZ' with clear sequential mini-flow 'Fotopigmento' → 'Transducina' → 'Fosfodiesterasa' → 'Disminuye el GMPc' → 'Se cierran canales catiónicos' → 'Hiperpolarización' → 'Disminuye el glutamato'. Card3 'BASTONES Y CONOS' with two subcolumns 'Bastones: poca luz, alta sensibilidad, menor detalle' and 'Conos: color y alta agudeza, especialmente en la fóvea'. Card4 'DE LA RETINA AL ENCÉFALO' with a simple three-neuron retinal schematic and labels 'Fotorreceptor' → 'Célula bipolar' → 'Célula ganglionar' → 'Nervio óptico'. Make it clear this row describes neural information flow, not direction of light incidence. Strong bottom colored callout exactly 'LA LUZ HIPERPOLARIZA AL FOTORRECEPTOR'. Small note 'Las células ganglionares generan los potenciales de acción de salida'. Footer 'Saladin · Capítulo 16 · Síntesis visual original'. Elegant educational anatomical illustration, readable exact Spanish labels, no generic icons, no superfluous decoration. Do not say photoreceptors fire more action potentials in the light; they signal with graded potentials and changes in glutamate release. Illustrations original and professional, clean line spacing and abundant padding.
